title: My Maker and my King
lyrics_original: To Thee my all I owe;
Thy sovereign bounty is the spring
Thy sovereign bounty is the spring
More praise than I can give.
More praise than I can give.
Thy love demands a thankful heart;
Thy love demands a thankful heart;
Let every word and each desire
And all my days be Thine.
Let every word and each desire
And all my days be Thine.

bible_verses.telugu: శ్రేష్ఠమైన ప్రతియీవియు సంపూర్ణమైన ప్రతి వరమును, పరసంబంధమైనదై, జ్యోతిర్మయుడగు తండ్రియొద్దనుండి వచ్చును; ఆయనయందు ఏ చంచలత్వమైనను గమనాగమనములవలన కలుగు ఏ ఛాయయైనను లేదు.
bible_verses.english: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.

bible_verses.telugu: నా ప్రాణమా, యెహోవాను సన్నుతించుము ఆయన చేసిన ఉపకారములలో దేనిని మరువకుము
bible_verses.english: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

bible_verses.telugu: మనమాయనయందు బ్రదుకుచున్నాము, చలించు చున్నాము, ఉనికి కలిగియున్నాము. అటువలెమన మాయన సంతానమని మీ కవీశ్వరులలో కొందరును చెప్పుచున్నారు.
bible_verses.english: ‘For in him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are his offspring.’

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, my Creator and King, I acknowledge that every good gift in my life comes from Your bountiful hand. Thank You for sustaining my breath and surrounding me with Your endless mercies each day. My highest praise feels small compared to Your great goodness, yet I freely offer You my heart. Teach me to walk in humble gratitude and depend completely on You for all things. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, my Creator and King, I acknowledge that every good gift in my life comes from Your bountiful hand. Teach me to walk in humble gratitude and depend completely on You for all things. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Every breath we take and every blessing we enjoy flows directly from the gracious heart of our Creator and King. When we pause to recognize that our very life is sustained by His sovereign love, our hearts naturally overflow with gratitude. Though our highest praise could never fully match the weight of His goodness, He deeply delights in the humble worship of His children. Today, let us freely offer Him our lives, resting in the joyful truth that in Him we live, move, and exist.
